title: Proposal: paid media and local search for Brackenmer Dental Group

in_your_words.quote: We spend about ten grand a month on Google and I honestly can't tell you what we get for it.
When someone new moves to town and searches for a dentist, I want all four offices to show up.
Our current agency sends a 30-page PDF every month. Nobody reads it.

cover_email.subject: Brackenmer proposal: 3 options, decision by 2026-11-13
cover_email.body: Hi both, thanks for the call. Attached is the proposal. Short version: your ads bring in about 190 booking requests and lead form submissions a month at $79 each, and about 14% of Google spend goes to searches that never book. At $18,000 a month we estimate 196 to 252 of them a month. Option B is the only one that also works on local search for all four offices. Can you pick an option by 2026-11-13? Happy to walk through it on a call.

trap_check.line: Our team provides unlimited revisions on all creative.
trap_check.fix: Cap at 2 revision rounds per deliverable; further rounds go through change requests.

trap_check.line: We handle ongoing optimization of your campaigns.
trap_check.fix: Name the monthly work: search term reviews weekly, bid and budget checks weekly, 8 new Meta ads a month.
Name the report: one page, monthly by the 5th business day, the KPIs in section 2, plus a live dashboard.

trap_check.line: We guarantee to double your leads within 90 days.
trap_check.fix: Remove. The audit projects 196 to 252 paid enquiries a month; doubling to 380 is above that range.

trap_check.line: Our clients average 4x return on ad spend.
trap_check.fix: Remove or replace with the one case study you have evidence for.

trap_check.line: You can reach your account team 24/7.
trap_check.fix: Replace with response times: 1 business day for email, same day for urgent ad issues.

trap_check.line: Creative for your ads is part of the package.
trap_check.fix: State the quantity: 8 new Meta ads a month (static or short video from client footage).
Add the exclusions list in section 6.
State that ad spend is paid by the client straight to Google and Meta and is not part of the fee.
Add client duties: access by day 3, ad approvals within 2 business days.

trap_check.line: a new online booking page for the cosmetic service line
trap_check.fix: Quote it as a separate project or list it under exclusions; it is in none of the options.

trap_check.line: You own your ad accounts and all creative we make for you.
missing: analytics (the GA4 property and Search Console)
trap_check.fix: Say the client also owns analytics (the GA4 property and Search Console), and keeps admin access to every account.
